subject: general
question: What is the value of {196 over 7} div {35 over 12} of {132 over 55} times {45 over 20}?
solution:
**Given:**

(196)/(7) div (35)/(12) of (132)/(55) times (45)/(20) = ?

**Formula used:**

BODMAS Rule (Of, Division, Multiplication, Addition, Subtraction)

**Calculations:**

(196)/(7) div (35)/(12) of (132)/(55) times (45)/(20)

⇒ 28 div ((35)/(12) times (132)/(55)) times (45)/(20)

⇒ 28 div ((35)/(55) times (132)/(12)) times (9)/(4)

⇒ 28 div ((7)/(11) times 11) times (9)/(4)

⇒ 28 div 7 times (9)/(4)

⇒ 4 times (9)/(4)

⇒ 9

**∴ The correct answer is option (4).**
